text: The district sports office guide is the highest-yield page for Paris 11e clubs: one PDF (oms-paris11.org/documents/BROCHURE_OMS_2026.pdf, clubs list pp.43-47) gives, per club, the président/présidente name, mobile and often a personal email - 40+ A-grade routes from one fetch. It should be read before any club site.

text: A club page can be another club's page: a GCERCCE news post mentioning ASC11's Japy class got its contact@ attributed to ASC11 by the reader. Attribution must be checked against the page's own identity before grading - I regraded it X then D once paris.fr confirmed the shared inbox.

text: The district's own two registers beat every federation: the OMS 11e yearbook PDF (annuaire des associations affiliées, pp.43-47) prints for each club the président(e) name + personal email + mobile, and the MVAC's Mailchimp annuaire prints an email and/or mobile per association with a 'Site internet' link. Both found by searching for the arrondissement's association directory, not for a federation club finder.
evidence: http://www.oms-paris11.org/documents/OMS-2025-2026.pdf (101 addresses in 41.8k chars); https://mailchi.mp/c679f28ad6fd/9d0e4locin (175 addresses, ~90 associations)

text: Federation club registers did not surface as usable lists: the long multi-federation query got HTTP 400 from serper, deepseek returned only regional PDF annuaires and competition guides, and the finders that did appear (monclub.ffhandball.fr, cartographie.ffhandball.fr) are JS maps with no crawlable row list. Went round it with the arrondissement's own registers (OMS, MVAC, mairie11) plus two open-data layers.
evidence: search 'annuaire des clubs fédération Paris 75011 ...' -> serper skipped HTTP 400, deepseek 12 results all PDFs/docs

Dropped both instead of logging in or paying a browse.

text: OMS PDF: direct download reader timed out (ConnectTimeout) but the finder had already read the same URL with TinyFish, so its extracted text was in the page library - the miner can reuse it instead of re-fetching. The roster's value is that each row prints a president/contact with a personal email; splitting the PDF text into clubs on 'Siege social' and assigning each email to the nearest preceding President/Contact label gave 61 of 62 rows a named contact.
evidence: miner/oms-rows.json: 44 clubs, 62 rows, 61 with email; pool contacts_from_rows=57

text: MVAC Mailchimp page: rows print most emails as plain text and only a minority as mailto: links (8/110), so a mailto-only parse silently loses them; the same page glues the previous entry's contact onto the next club (Aikido Club du 11e shows Budo XI's address first, then its own), so the first email on a row is not always that row's.
evidence: miner/mvac-rows.json: 110 entries with email after adding plain-text regex; Aikido row had <email> before <email>

text: Second package confirmed the pattern on 7 of 10: the OMS 11e brochure (p.43-45) alone gave a named président·e with a personal address for AS Bouvines, ASCP XI, Aïkido Club du 11e, Amicale Bouliste du Père Lachaise and AS PVP 11e, plus a role mailbox for APSAP VP and CODERS 75 - while the organisations' own sites yielded nothing above C/D. Reading the district guide first is ~10x cheaper than per-club crawling.
evidence: BROCHURE_OMS_2026.pdf pp.43-45; 7 of 10 orgs resolved A/B from it

text: The pool carries wrong websites: ASSOCIATION SPORTIVE CANNE D'ARME had sortiraparis.com as its website (a listings site), so 15 pages were read for nothing; its real site batoncanne.com was found only from the brochure. The websites lane should be corrected from the brochure's per-club URL column - one pass over pp.43-47 would fix a whole batch of these.
evidence: orgs(ids=[org-c4b58cbb6e]) website https://www.sortiraparis.com/ vs brochure 'Site web : https://www.batoncanne.com'

text: For this market the yield order is: district/brochure PDF (président + personal email) > club site mentions légales > club site contact page (generic inbox + phone) > city activity sheet (contact@ shared with the administering club). A researcher's first action on a Paris club should be to look for the organisation's entry in the OMS brochure before touching its website.
evidence: two packages, 15 organisations, 10 A/B rows; brochure rows win on both grade and cost

text: Opendatasoft portals: /explore/dataset/<id>/export/?format=csv serves the HTML page, not the CSV. The export that works is /api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/<id>/exports/csv?delimiter=%3B. Bonus: the v2 export of Paris Data's occupation des créneaux keeps telephone_du_contact and adresse_mail_du_contact, which the finder's note said were absent - the 75011 slice alone gave 104 contacts. Also worth knowing: pooling one slot file twice (into=venues group_by=association, then into=orgs name=association) yields the facility view and the contacts; the venue pass does not attach row addresses.
evidence: miner/pd-75011.json: 748 rows, 124 associations, 114 with email; pool orgs pass contacts_from_rows=104

text: Sweep lane ends empty after a waited claim (wait=50) while 299 organisations stay not_read: the run's own brief.max_per_source=8 caps every pooled source (Mairie 11e 8/8, OMS 11e 8/8, Paris Data 8/8, MVAC 5 dropped = 29 = pipeline_done), so the planner has nothing left that is eligible to package. text: 这轮不能直接进 0.7.3 基线表：简报多了一个 max_per_source=8（and fresh_since），而 references/benchmarks.md 的标准 smoke 简报里没有这个键。它把每个数据源的上限钉在 8 家，4 个源合计 29 家就自然到底，sweep 通道看起来「空」而 299 家未读——这是我自己造的上限，不是规划器的缺陷。另外文档要求空 MARKETOPS_HOME 才是真正的 from zero，这轮用的是共享库 + brief.fresh=true（无 brought-in 源，但 pages/searches 池是热的）。
